findings.candidate_quote: Limitations include the use of a single cell line
findings.reference_quote:
Killing assays were conducted by co-culturing primary negatively isolated NK cells with Panc02 and
KPC3595 cells, as well as NK-92 cells with SU.86.86 cells.
findings.explanation: The study used multiple PDAC target cell lines, including KPC3595 to validate sex-dependent immune responses. Although the allograft experiments used Panc02 alone, the summary presents single-cell-line use as a limitation of the entire study.
